description: This file defines utility classes for serial execution of asynchronous functions within the Orleans framework. It includes a generic AsyncSerialExecutor<TResult> class for serializing async tasks and a non-generic AsyncSerialExecutor class that wraps the generic one for void-returning tasks.

classes.name: AsyncSerialExecutor<TResult>
classes.description: A utility class that provides serial execution of asynchronous functions of type TResult, ensuring that submitted tasks execute one after another without interleaving.

classes.name: AsyncSerialExecutor
classes.description: A non-generic utility class that wraps AsyncSerialExecutor<bool> to provide serial execution for async functions that do not return a value.

classes.name: InterlockedExchangeLock
classes.description: A nested class within AsyncSerialExecutor<TResult> that implements a lock mechanism relying on Interlocked.Exchange to manage lock state atomically.

methods.name: AddNext
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous function for serial execution, returning a Task representing its completion.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: A private static method that wraps a Func<Task> to produce a Task<bool> that completes with true after the function executes.

methods.name: TryGetLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock atomically, returning true if successful.
